#### **We Help Founders at Any Level**

We believe that while people and ideas are equally distributed, opportunity and resources are not. That’s why we are committed to increasing access to entrepreneurship — all over the world.

![working session founder catalyst sized](https://cdn.bfldr.com/CBWQP80B/as/rtrvxx6snvs895q32qc3wj/working_session_founder_catalyst_sized?auto=auto&format=auto&width=1000)

###### **Techstars Founder Catalyst**

Founder Catalyst is a 10-week, pre-accelerator program that provides participants with the training, tools, mentorship, and network to prepare them for the next level.

[Learn more](https://www.techstars.com/founder-catalyst?__hstc=124297685.d18dfba50d89a11f070a818f3684d3c9.1718408678005.1719510570218.1719515415920.20&__hssc=124297685.1.1719515415920&__hsfp=3530606189)

![pitch startup weekend sized](https://cdn.bfldr.com/CBWQP80B/as/f47zk6mc3b97cghnmht8qxrg/pitch_startup_weekend_sized?auto=auto&format=auto&width=1000)

###### **Techstars Startup Weekend**

Startup Weekend is a three-day program where aspiring entrepreneurs can experience startup life by learning the ins and outs of launching their own startup.

[Learn more](https://www.techstars.com/communities/startup-weekend?__hstc=124297685.d18dfba50d89a11f070a818f3684d3c9.1718408678005.1719589265125.1719873837473.25&__hssc=124297685.47.1719873837473&__hsfp=3530606189)

![stage startup week sized](https://cdn.bfldr.com/CBWQP80B/as/sqfsfqk8mcfrfkh7bctf92b/stage_startup_week_sized?auto=auto&format=auto&width=1000)

###### **Techstars Startup Week**

Startup Week is a celebration of entrepreneurship in your city, featuring dozens of sessions, an opening ceremony, keynote speakers, pitch competitions, and more.

[Learn more](https://www.techstars.com/communities/startup-week?__hstc=124297685.d18dfba50d89a11f070a818f3684d3c9.1718408678005.1719589265125.1719873837473.25&__hssc=124297685.55.1719873837473&__hsfp=3530606189)

#### **Join Our Worldwide Network**

Since 2006, Techstars has been on a mission to help founders succeed. We do this by operating accelerator programs and venture capital funds, and by helping build thriving startup communities around the world.

![mentors-foundercon-graphic](https://cdn.bfldr.com/CBWQP80B/as/cwj43bc874nmjpt8tp7jbft/mentors-foundercon-graphic?auto=auto&format=auto&width=1000)

##### Mentors

Mentors are an essential part of our culture. By freely sharing their wisdom and guidance, they impact the entire network and create real, lasting relationships. Techstars mentors come from top companies like Google, Nike, Amazon, Aetna, ESPN, Coca-Cola, and more.

[Meet our mentors](https://www.techstars.com/mentors)

![Partners Graphic Update V3 (1)](https://cdn.bfldr.com/CBWQP80B/as/f9ph3r3qcsjgbw6vmg8p5gg/Partners_Graphic_Update_V3_1?auto=auto&format=auto&width=1000)

##### Partners

Whether you’re looking to build your local startup community, interact with the world’s top startups, or invest in startups that are making an impact in your industry, Techstars offers a variety of ways to engage with our network that align with your business goals.

[Partner with us](https://www.techstars.com/partner)

![Investor Alt Img](https://cdn.bfldr.com/CBWQP80B/as/npnpp623w57cq4rxqtwbrjc/Investor_Alt_Img?auto=auto&format=auto&width=1000)

##### Investors

Techstars is a leading pre-seed venture capital firm, investing in a diverse, global pool of entrepreneurs and high-growth companies. Since our first accelerator launched in 2007, Techstars has supported founders and delivered strong and consistent returns to investors.

[Invest in the future](https://www.techstars.com/investors)
